title: California e-bike mods check
jurisdiction: California statewide, with a City of San Diego layer where its code adds a rule
how_sources_were_read: leginfo.legislature.ca.gov pages returned HTTP 403 from Cloudflare to curl, WebFetch and the browse binary on Oct 21, 2026. No attempt was made to get past it. Statute and bill text was read instead from the Legislature's official bulk data files on downloads.leginfo.legislature.ca.gov, which hold the same database, by reading only the needed members with HTTP range requests. pubinfo_2025.zip was dated Oct 18, 2026 PT and pubinfo_daily_Tue.zip Oct 20, 2026 PT. Each source gives the leginfo page URL for people and the bulk file member actually read in read_via. CHP, DMV and San Diego pages were fetched directly.
effective_date_rule: SB 1167 and AB 2346 were chaptered Sep 30, 2026 with URGENCY No in the bill version table. Under Cal. Const. art. IV, sec. 8(c)(1), a regular session statute takes effect on January 1 next following a 90-day period from enactment, so both take effect Jan 1, 2027.

effective_date_rule_quote.quote: shall go into effect on January 1 next following a 90-day period

legal_effect_values.same_class: The bike stays an e-bike of the same class. Other rules may still apply.
legal_effect_values.different_class: The bike now matches a different class. The label must be replaced and that class's rules apply.
legal_effect_values.not_an_ebike: The bike is no longer an e-bike. It is a motor vehicle and needs the license, registration and insurance for its type.
legal_effect_values.depends_on_result: The legal effect depends on what the change does to motor-only speed, assisted speed or motor power. See outcomes.
legal_effect_values.unresolved: The sources read do not settle it. The app should say it cannot confirm the bike is legal.
legal_effect_values.unresolved_until_2027_then_not_an_ebike: Unclear under current text, and not an e-bike from Jan 1, 2027.

quote_rule: Every quote is verbatim from the primary text and under 15 words. A second reader checked each one against an independent copy on Oct 21, 2026.

default_infraction_penalties.for: Breaking a Vehicle Code rule that names no other penalty
default_infraction_penalties.penalty_as_written: It is an infraction unless the code says otherwise.
default_infraction_penalties.quote: it is unlawful and constitutes an infraction

default_infraction_penalties.for: Fine for an infraction when the code names no other fine
default_infraction_penalties.penalty_as_written: Fine up to $100. Up to $200 for a second infraction within one year of a prior conviction. Up to $250 for a third or later infraction within one year of two or more prior convictions. VC 42001(d) lets a local public entity that employs peace officers, CSU and UC set a bicycle fine schedule that does not go above the code's maximum.
default_infraction_penalties.quote: By a fine not exceeding one hundred dollars ($100).

if_no_longer_an_ebike.says: Only an electric bicycle is exempt from the license, registration, license plate and insurance rules, and only an electric bicycle is declared not a motor vehicle. A bike that stops meeting 312.5 loses that exemption.
if_no_longer_an_ebike.quote: an electric bicycle is not a motor vehicle

if_no_longer_an_ebike.says: A self-propelled vehicle is a motor vehicle.
if_no_longer_an_ebike.quote: A “motor vehicle” is a vehicle that is self-propelled.

if_no_longer_an_ebike.says: Until Dec 31, 2026, a two or three wheeled device with operative pedals, or no pedals if all electric, with an automatic transmission, under 4 gross brake horsepower and 30 mph or less on level ground is a motorized bicycle or moped.
if_no_longer_an_ebike.quote: a motor that produces less than 4 gross brake horsepower

if_no_longer_an_ebike.says: A motorized bicycle or moped needs a Class M2 license or endorsement. A two-wheel motorcycle or motor-driven cycle needs Class M1. Anyone under 21 must first finish a novice motorcycle safety training program.
if_no_longer_an_ebike.quote: Class M2 includes a motorized bicycle or moped

if_no_longer_an_ebike.says: DMV says a moped rider needs an M1 or M2 license, must be at least 16 and must wear a helmet. Registration needs special plates, an identification card and a one-time $23 fee. DMV says insurance is not needed to register a moped.
if_no_longer_an_ebike.quote: You must have a motorcycle license (M1 or M2) to drive a moped.

if_no_longer_an_ebike.says: A motorized bicycle must display a special DMV license plate.
if_no_longer_an_ebike.quote: is required to display a special license plate

if_no_longer_an_ebike.says: DMV registers a moped that can go faster than 30 mph as a motor-driven cycle, a kind of motorcycle. Fees are due the first time it is ridden after a modification that raises its speed past 30 mph.
if_no_longer_an_ebike.quote: subject to registration as a motor-driven cycle (motorcycle)

if_no_longer_an_ebike.says: Riders and passengers on a motorcycle, motor-driven cycle or motorized bicycle must wear a motorcycle safety helmet on highways.
if_no_longer_an_ebike.quote: shall wear a safety helmet

mods.name: Higher-voltage or bigger battery
